facts.what: 昨夜激烈性爱后他冷淡；她手臂留下他按住她的黄圈
facts.anchor: I notice small yellow circles dotted across my arm from where his hands pinned me to the bed, rendering me submissive.

facts.what: 认为 George 自见母亲后变了，此前他最爱她的 edge
facts.anchor: since we went for lunch with his mum, it’s almost like he can’t stand me.

facts.what: 咖啡洒在新漆窗台，等他发作却没来，用小臂擦净
facts.anchor: I wait with bated breath for the childlike tantrum to erupt, but it doesn’t come

facts.what: 称他扔了她的低胸上衣、换成高领与长袖，她反觉得自己不识好歹
facts.anchor: I swear he threw out a bunch of my low-cut tops and replaced them with high-neck polos and long-sleeved dresses

facts.what: 她全部物品只放在一米五长、潮湿发霉的储物柜；他的衣柜与抽屉大量空位
facts.anchor: This is my domain in here, in this cupboard.

facts.what: 今晨收到中奖通知，可当天预约那位通灵师
facts.anchor: I got a notification this morning that I’d won that competition, and I could claim a slot today.

facts.what: 质疑她不是不信这些吗；她说是为他近来反常才去求助
facts.anchor: You said you don’t believe in any of that shit.

facts.what: 她赌气出门，他喊她回来；她跑起来，怕再来一次被劝住
facts.anchor: Maybe I’m worried he’ll come after me again like he did last night and convince me to stay.

relations: Blair 与 George 同居；他控制她的衣着与行动；她决定去求助通灵师
